version: v1 (Tomas, round 4). Cameron's Kick as printed in Barflies and Cocktails (1927; F12): a third scotch, a third Irish whiskey, a sixth each of lemon and orgeat. The book's sixths (30/30/15/15) run OUT on acid (initial 1.00 vs 1.2; finished 0.64 vs 0.76), so the lemon goes to 22.5 ml and the orgeat to 17.5 ml; the whiskies stay half and half. Spark: the fly, three whole roasted coffee beans floated on top (sambuca 'con la mosca', Oxford SAMBUCA pdf 1723; the IBF emblem is a housefly, F17); coffee, almond and citrus all sit on the Flavor Matrix Grain wheel (pdf 137, page image checked). Garnish only: no coffee in the drink.
